page_title: LIL 1-0 MON | Lille v Monaco 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' CHANCE! Mika Biereth (Monaco) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
90+9' Olivier Giroud (Lille) fails to score from the penalty kick. His shot goes just a few inches over the crossbar.
90+7' Christian Mawissa (Monaco) picks up a yellow card.
90+7' It's a penalty for Lille!
90+7' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

90+1' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Mathias Fernandez-Pardo, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Olivier Giroud (Lille), who beats Lukas Hradecky with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 1:0.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Wasted opportunity. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
88' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for an infringement.
87' It's like he was asking for a caution. Lamine Camara (Monaco) receives a yellow card.
86' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) is brought on as a substitute for Caio Henrique.
83' Bruno Genesio appears to have said too much and referee Willy Delajod comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
81' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Felix Correia and he is replaced by Nabil Bentaleb (Lille).
81' Benjamin Andre (Lille) misses a huge chance from inside the penalty area after unleashing a powerful first-time volley towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.
80' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is about to take a corner kick.
79' Felix Correia (Lille) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The ball is out of play. Lille win a corner kick.
78' Mika Biereth (Monaco) commits a foul and Willy Delajod immediately signals a free kick.

77' Well-positioned Vanderson (Monaco) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Berke Ozer reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
76' The resulting corner from Caio Henrique (Monaco) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
74' It is time for a substitution. Eliesse Ben Seghir is on for Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco).
74' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) goes off the pitch and Mika Biereth comes on.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Teze leaves the pitch and Vanderson (Monaco) comes on.
73' Olivier Giroud (Lille) gets on the end of a cross from Felix Correia, but his shot goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
72' Eric Dier (Monaco) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

71' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.

69' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
68' Romain Perraud (Lille) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

68' Thomas Meunier (Lille) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lille.
67' Thomas Meunier (Lille) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
66' A lofted cross from Caio Henrique (Monaco) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
66' Caio Henrique (Monaco) will take the corner.
66' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Monaco will take a corner.
65' A pass by Eric Dier (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Lille will take a throw-in.
63' Benjamin Andre (Lille) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lukas Hradecky comes off the line to clear the ball away.

62' What an opportunity! Olivier Giroud (Lille) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
61' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Romain Perraud (Lille).
61' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Lille can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Bruno Genesio is forced to make a change. Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Mathias Fernandez-Pardo.
58' It doesn’t look good for Ngalayel Mukau (Lille); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
57' Looks like Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
55' The referee awards a corner and Romain Perraud (Lille) goes over to take it.
55' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. It will be a corner kick for Lille.
53' The referee blows his whistle as Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) was too aggressive in his challenge. Lille are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
51' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Romain Perraud (Lille).
48' Felix Correia (Lille) is penalised for a foul. Willy Delajod had a clear view and blows his whistle.
46' The whistle blows and Willy Delajod starts the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
43' A long ball forward to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is intercepted.
39' Lamine Camara links up with Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco), who fires just wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
38' Olivier Giroud (Lille) is flagged for offside.
38' The foul by Takumi Minamino (Monaco) was seen by Willy Delajod who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' Half-chance! Felix Correia (Lille) plays a pass into the box, but Lukas Hradecky reacts well to snuff out the attack.

35' What a chance that is! Thomas Meunier (Lille) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
34' There's an opportunity for Romain Perraud (Lille) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
34' Thomas Meunier (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Good work from Lille as they win a corner.
33' The resulting corner from Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is cleared.
33' Felix Correia (Lille) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Lille.
32' The corner from Romain Perraud (Lille) is intercepted by the defence.
32' Felix Correia (Lille) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Lille have a corner.
31' Willy Delajod blows for a foul after Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
30' Monaco players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
28' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
27' Alexsandro (Lille) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is behind the touchline and Monaco will take a throw-in.
24' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Willy Delajod interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Eric Dier (Monaco).
21' A great run from Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
21' Caio Henrique (Monaco) steps up to send the ball in.
20' Caio Henrique (Monaco) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Thomas Meunier (Lille) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
17' The cross into the penalty area from Takumi Minamino (Monaco) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.

17' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
17' The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
16' A cross into the box from Romain Perraud (Lille) is cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lille.

14' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
11' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
9' The ball is crossed into the box and Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Berke Ozer gets a glove on it to thwart him.
7' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
7' Romain Perraud (Lille) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
2' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Lille will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will supervise the game today.
